message_pattern: http status code is: <NNN>  (main-document status of each visited page; Info)
dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && $d.message ~ 'http status code is: ' && !($d.message ~ 'is: 200') | groupby $l.subsystemname, $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name'] as job, $d.message aggregate count() as n, any_value($d.context.url) as url | orderby n desc
noise: Sporadic 404/403 are normal. Signal = share of non-200 within one job: a job where most visits are 403/405 => A1, many 429 => A5; 202 often = bot-manager interstitial (Akamai/Cloudflare 'please wait') => A2. 30x rarely appear here because redirects are followed (see final_url line).
notes: Primary access signal. 403/405 -> A1, 429 -> A5, 202 -> A2 candidate, 401 -> B5/B3, 404 on seed -> C4. Join with job id to see whether it hits all pages.

message_pattern: [browser] [error] Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of <NNN> (<text>)
dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && $d.message ~ 'Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of' | extract $d.message into $d.sc using regexp(e=/status of (?<code>[0-9]{3})/) | groupby $l.subsystemname, $d.sc.code aggregate count() as n, approx_count_distinct($d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name']) as jobs
noise: Mostly sub-resource (JS/XHR/images) failures — noisy; NOT the page status. Template f8cca772 is shared with any [browser] [error] console line.
notes: Only meaningful when it coincides with a non-200 'http status code is' for the document, or as a burst of 401 after login (B5).

message_pattern: not including url in result url set. reason: final url not included in whitelist
dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && $l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' && $d.message ~ 'final url not included in whitelist' | groupby $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name'] as job aggregate count() as n, any_value($d.context.url) as url | orderby n desc
key_fields: $d.context.url (the requested URL, final URL not printed)
noise: Normal for external links when whitelist is the site domain. Signal = the SEED URL (or every URL of the job) rejected => 0-page crawl.
notes: Message does not show the final URL; pair with 'finished waiting for page to stabilize. final url after redirections' / 'successfully scraped url. final url:' for the same request_id, and the whitelist from scan-worker 'crawler config is:'.

message_pattern: not including url in result url set. reason: (final url is included in blacklist|final url was already visited. this is most likely due to a redirection|sanitized url was already visited|content type <x> is not allowed|max number of successful visits was reached|language is not included in whitelist|matching grouping rule <re> is full})
dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.message ~ 'not including url in result url set' | extract $d.message into $d.rx using regexp(e=/reason: (?<reason>[a-zA-Z _.:-]{0,60})/) | groupby $l.subsystemname, $d.rx.reason aggregate count() as n | orderby n desc
volume: 7d: blacklist 129,745; already visited via redirect 57,791; sanitized dup 17,843; content-type ~20.6k; max visits 2,279; language 1,119; grouping full ~1.9k; text/HTML case 110
noise: Mostly benign bookkeeping. Signals: 'language is not included in whitelist' on every URL of a job (C1 locale filter); 'final url was already visited ... redirection' burst (many URLs redirect to the same login/error/geo page => B5/C4/A7); 'content type text/HTML; charset=utf-8 is not allowed' (case-sensitive content-type bug => site loses all pages).
notes: Reason 'final url is included in ...' is truncated in the log line itself (blacklist).

dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.message ~ 'failed due to' | extract $d.message into $d.fr using regexp(e=/(?<kind>[A-Z]+) with id \S+ failed due to (?<reason>[A-Z_0-9]+)/) | groupby $l.subsystemname, $d.fr.kind, $d.fr.reason aggregate count() as n, approx_count_distinct($d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name']) as jobs | orderby n desc
volume: 7d: CRAWL OPEN_PAGE_TIMEOUT 30,788 (60 jobs); SCAN OPEN_PAGE_TIMEOUT 13,545 (34); CRAWL 'undefined' 4,435 (8); SCAN PAGE_INTERACTION_PLUGIN_ERROR 560 (6); SCAN PLUGIN_TIMEOUT 421; SCAN FAILED_TO_RUN_ENGINES 201; CRAWL INTERNAL_ERROR 170; DNS_ERROR_COULD_NOT_FIND_URL 25 crawl/24 scan; CRAWL PAGE_INTERACTION_PLUGIN_ERROR 18
noise: One line per failed URL (Info severity!). OPEN_PAGE_TIMEOUT on nearly all URLs of a job => block/tarpit (A1/A5) or down site; scattered => slow pages.
notes: The enum has no HTTP/WAF-specific value (no BLOCKED/HTTP_403) — blocks surface as OPEN_PAGE_TIMEOUT or as successful pages with 403 status. PAGE_INTERACTION_PLUGIN_ERROR carries 'No element found for selector: <sel>' and the url the browser was on (B2; if url is an unexpected page => A7/B1/B4). DNS_ERROR_COULD_NOT_FIND_URL => C4.

dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && $d.message ~ 'config is: {' | extract $d.message into $d.ua using regexp(e=/--user-agent=(?<ua>[^"]{0,160})/) | extract $d.message into $d.p using regexp(e=/"propertyName":"(?<prop>[^"]+)"/) | groupby $d.p.prop, $d.ua.ua aggregate count() as n | orderby n desc
noise: Configuration, not an error. Always present; use it as context for the property under investigation.
notes: UA 'HeadlessChrome/65...' or 'Chrome/65...' => A6 risk (~25% of pages in 7d). extraHeaders non-null => custom header configured. whitelist/languageWhitelist regexes to test against seed/final URL for C1/C2. parallelNum>1 with login => B5 risk. Never copy extraHeaders values or interaction credentials from this line.

message_pattern: browser was opened successfully. version: Chrome/<ver>
dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && $m.templateid == 'd1d6dbd8-9c4f-11f1-8905-329537c5ee79' | groupby $d.message aggregate count() as n, approx_count_distinct($d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name']) as jobs
volume: 340k/7d (one per page open), single value Chrome/126.0.6478.126
notes: Shows the engine, not the UA header sent. A6 must be judged from the --user-agent in the config dump.

message_pattern: finished waiting for page to stabilize. final url after redirections: <url> | successfully scraped url. final url: <url> | current page url: <url>
dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && $d.message ~ 'final url after redirections' | extract $d.message into $d.fu using regexp(e=/redirections: (?<u>\S+)/) | create landing from if($d.fu.u:string.matches(/(?i)\/(u\/)?(login|signin|sign-in|logon|authenticate|sso|mfa|otp|challenge)|out-of-country|\/404|\/500|not-found|error/), 'login/error/geo', 'normal') | groupby $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name'] as job, landing aggregate count() as n, any_value($d.fu.u) as sample | orderby n desc
volume: one per visited page (tens of thousands/day); login-like landings ~600/12h (e.g. ulta.com /u/login 82+488 lines in 3 jobs)
noise: Normal pages dominate. Signal = high share of landings on login/mfa/out-of-country/404/500 within one job, or seed final URL on another host.
notes: Path decides: /login after successful login => B5 (B3 if login never succeeded); /mfa|/otp => B1; out-of-country/geo => A7 (sky.de example); /404|/500 => C4; other host => C2.

message_pattern: got error while scraping No element found for selector: <sel> | element: <sel>, exists: false, in an iframe: <bool> | (CRAWL|SCAN) with id .. failed due to PAGE_INTERACTION_PLUGIN_ERROR - {.."message":"No element found for selector: <sel>"}
dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && ($d.message ~ 'No element found for selector' || $d.message ~ 'exists: false') | groupby $l.subsystemname, $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name'] as job aggregate count() as n, any_value(substr($d.message:string,0,250)) as sample | orderby n desc
volume: 7d: 'got error while scraping No element found' 1,683 scan (4 jobs) + 97 crawl (8 jobs); PAGE_INTERACTION_PLUGIN_ERROR 560 scan + 18 crawl
noise: Always a real failure of a configured interaction; repeats per page in scan (each page re-logs-in?).
notes: If error.url is the expected login page => B2 (selector drift). If error.url is an unexpected page (out-of-country, /authenticate SSO hop, MFA) => A7/B4/B1. 'in an iframe: true' hints at modal/SSO (B4).

message_pattern: starting page interaction plugin | typing text in element: <sel> | clicking element: <sel>
dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && ($d.message ~ 'typing text in element' || $d.message ~ 'clicking element' || $d.message ~ 'starting page interaction plugin') | groupby $l.subsystemname, $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name'] as job, $d.message aggregate count() as n | orderby job
noise: Background for authenticated properties; use as the trace of which step ran last before a failure.
notes: Typed values are not logged (good). Config dumps (TYPE_TEXT/CLICK_ELEMENT, loginConfiguration) may contain credentials: never copy. No 'bound handleRequest execution took more than 300000' seen in sample day.

message_pattern: got error while scraping net::ERR_<X> at <url>
dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && $d.message ~ 'got error while scraping net::' | extract $d.message into $d.e using regexp(e=/(?<err>net::[A-Z_0-9]+)/) | groupby $l.subsystemname, $d.e.err, $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name'] as job aggregate count() as n, any_value($d.context.url) as url | orderby n desc
noise: Low volume, each is meaningful when concentrated in one job/host.
notes: ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS => A8; ERR_CONNECTION_RESET/REFUSED concentrated on one host => A1 (WAF/IP deny); ERR_HTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR => A1/A5. Most 'got error while scraping' lines (~123k/7d) have no detail — those are timeouts, see page_failed_due_to_reason.

dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && $m.templateid == '1212cbf6-9fa9-11f1-94dc-5ee20c2e67e1' | extract $d.message into $d.v using regexp(e=/visited (?<n>\d+) pages/) | groupby $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name'] as job aggregate max($d.v.n:number) as maxv | filter maxv <= 1
noise: Counter itself is benign; the per-job max is the signal.
notes: Finds 0/1-page crawls; then apply the decision recipe (status codes, whitelist reasons, interaction errors, 'filtered out: N urls'). Jobs that visit 0 pages may never print it — cross-check with scan-worker/scrape-server scanTotalUrls.

dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && $l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' && $d.message ~ 'filtered out: ' | groupby $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name'] as job aggregate count() as n, any_value($d.message) as sample
notes: 1-page crawl with 'filtered out: 0 urls' => no links found (C6 / challenge page); high N => links found but out of scope (C1/C2).

message_pattern: page <url> in scan <id> completed. <k> scan pages finished - waiting for <M> to be completed | METRIC_EVENT {.."eventType":"scan.page.complete",.."scanTotalUrls":"<M>"..}
dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $l.subsystemname == 'scrape-server' && $m.templateid == '81c746f6-aa4a-11f1-ba0a-6686f8ca4618' | extract $d.message into $d.s using regexp(e=/in scan (?<scan>\S+) completed\. \d+ scan pages finished - waiting for (?<m>\d+)/) | groupby $d.s.scan aggregate max($d.s.m:number) as total | filter total <= 1
notes: Gives scan size per scanId, linking a ticket's scan to a 1-page crawl.

dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && ($l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' || $l.subsystemname == 'scan-worker') | groupby $l.subsystemname, $d.resource.attributes['k8s.node.name'] as node aggregate approx_count_distinct($d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name']) as jobs
noise: All prod jobs sampled ran on '*-pool-stat*' pools
notes: No egress IP is logged. A crawl that has no crawl-worker k8s job at all may have run on the fast tier (Cloud Function production_crawl_link_extractor — not present in Coralogix gcp/logs over 7d). Confirm A4 from Retool flags, not logs.
